Pre-rendered voices for exams, dialogues, minimal pairs and grammar

Audio packs hold natural pre-rendered Japanese (VOICEVOX) for exam listening, dialogues, minimal pairs, the pitch test and grammar examples. The pitch and minimal-pair packs come with the app. The others are files you install here: pick a pack file you downloaded, or type the address of a server that hosts them (yours, a NAS, or the one that runs your sync server). Tsumugi has no built-in download address. Without a pack, the phone\'s text-to-speech voice reads the lines.
